proc_p: Worktops are made once your kitchen layout is fixed, and we agree the fitting date with you.
steps: We look at your kitchen, talk through materials and check the sink, hob and tap positions.
You choose from real samples at home, and the quote lists every cut-out, upstand and edge.
Each worktop is measured so the joints, cut-outs and edges sit exactly where they should.
Our fitters install the worktops and seal the joints, covered by our 12-month guarantee.
